notes.ratings_tuned_2019_2023: the rating systems' scale parameters (and the market rating's) were tuned by their own tools on 2019-2023, so their 2019-2023 slopes are near 1 partly by construction; 2012-2018 is the cleaner view of their drift
notes.ml_oof: ML v1/v2 2012-2023 rows are annual expanding refits (out of fold); ML v2's blocks, penalty and rating parameters were chosen on CV years 2016-2023, a mild optimism that does not touch 2024+
notes.stacks: stack_<head> = tools/ml2.py's page stacks refit each year on 2013..Y-1 (long history), ml2's half-lives (no line 1.5 y; open / line none)
notes.line_source: close/open before 2019 (and non-dev fights) come from nlbair (BFO no-vig); 2019+ dev fights from market.json (power de-vig consensus close, multiplicative no-vig open)

cv.decision_rule: Per head and scheme family, the hyper-parameters are chosen by pooled log loss over the rolling origins 2016-2020 (each year predicted only from earlier fights, per-card refits where the scheme refits per card). A family passes the gate only if BOTH (a) its 2016-2020 choice and (b) its best configuration on the forward-chained years 2021-2023 beat the incumbent (ml2's own stack fit 2019..Y-1 with its CV half-life; the ML v2 logistic as published) by more than 0.0005 pooled log loss on 2021-2023 (ml2's selection rule). Among passing families the one whose 2016-2020 choice scores best on 2021-2023 is adopted; if none passes, the head keeps the incumbent (no recalibration). Fixed before any cv output was read; 2024-2025 never enters.

rule.inputs: 2021-2023 backtest-universe fights (1,224): ML v2 logistic OOF + market rating logits

production.source: ml2.json stacks.page_stack.noline (refit 2019-2025, h 1.5): the page / production no-line stack

validated.source: ml2.json stacks.weights['noline|page: ml2lr+mkt_rating'] (fit 2019-2023): the validated stack

rule.reading: a 'true' slope s on the validated stack's logit means outcomes follow sig(s * z_valid); s = 1 is 2019-2023-like calibration (the validated stack's 2021-2023 slope is about 1.08), s = 1.37 is the published 2024-25 slope of the validated stack (ml2.json stacks.valid, static); the production stack then shows a slope of about s / k
rule.production_refit_note: tools/ml2.py stack_predict(scheme 'roll', fit_until_year 2025): the production procedure (OOF 2019-2023 + monthly-rolling 2024-2025 rows); h 1.5 reproduces the published page weights. Only weights are computed; no 2024-25 prediction is scored

break_even.reading: switching to h 3 lowers expected log loss only when the true slope (validated scale) is below s*, i.e. when the production stack's own slope is below t*

meta.statement: Written and committed to git before tools/calib.py confirm reads any 2024-2025 row. The choice per head below follows the decision rule on <= 2023 data only. The confirm stage scores it once on 2024-01-01..2025-12-31 (backtest universe, event-cluster CIs). The descriptive rows (each scheme family's 2016-2020 choice, run walk-forward through 2024-25) are reported for the record; by this pre-registration no 2024-25 number can change the choice, the decision rule or the production spec.
